title: Top Tips For Decorating A Period Property

seo.title: Top Tips For Decorating A Period Property
seo.description: If you live in a period property you’ll want to make the most of the period features in your home. Here are some top decorating tips for a period property.

heading: Top Tips For Decorating A Period Property
bodyHtml:
If you live in a period property you’ll no doubt want to make the most of the period features in your home. After all, it’s often these elements that make a property really stand out. This is especially going to be the case if you’ve sent an antique item for metal polishing in London to bring it back to its best.

But it can sometimes be difficult to know how best to show these features off, or how to decorate your home in a way that properly complements them. Real Homes recently offered some tips on how to decorate your period home in a rustic country style.

One tip is to consider how you can use wallpaper to create the atmosphere you’re looking for in specific rooms. Choosing wallpaper with a repeat pattern is a great option for the dining room, the news provider suggested.

It also recommended choosing natural tones to paint your walls in, as this will enhance the rural and rustic feel in your home.

But it’s not all about what you put on the walls. You can use rustic woven fabrics in various rooms to help accent period features and complete the aesthetic. Don’t be afraid of mixing and matching the patterns of the fabrics you select either.

In the UK, it’s certainly clear that we love our period properties. Earlier this year, Ideal Home shared research from Anglian Home Improvements, which found that Georgian properties were the most architecturally appealing in the country.

Victorian and Tudor homes followed in second and third place in the list respectively.
